title: LLM API Pricing 2026: Full Comparison Table (Weekly)
description: LLM API pricing 2026: 51 models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, and Mistral in one table. Input/output cost per 1M tokens, updated weekly.

attribution.citation: Json House, "LLM API Pricing 2026: Full Comparison Table (Weekly)", jsonhouse.com (2026-09-28)

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek retired v4-flash on 2026-09-14 and serves the same model name from deepseek-flash (build DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) at $0.15/$0.60 per 1M tokens off-peak; against the 2026-08-17 increase to $0.22/$0.66 this reverses the rise on input (+7% versus the pre-increase $0.14) but not on output (+114% versus the pre-increase $0.28), taking DeepSeek output-to-input from 2x to 3x to 4x across the three states
Anthropic cancelled the scheduled 2026-09-01 increase of Claude Sonnet 5 from $2/$10 to $3/$15 per 1M tokens; the introductory rate became the standard price

No price in the tracked set changed in the five weekly collections from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-28 — input, output and cache read held at all six providers — while the 2026-09-28 collection added four models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6-sol, GPT-6-luna, Grok 4.7) and removed none, taking the set from 47 to 51
key_facts.source: jsonhouse weekly pricing snapshot series, collections of 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28

key_facts.fact: Claude 4.7 and later models, plus Claude Mythos Preview, use a tokenizer that produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text than Sonnet 4.6 and earlier — 9 of the 14 tracked Anthropic rows, Claude Opus 5.5 included — so an unchanged per-token price on those rows is not an unchanged cost per unit of text, and per-token comparison across that line or across providers is an approximation

Anthropic sets the cache-read multiplier per model: 0.1x base input on most of its line, 0.05x on Claude Opus 5.5 ($0.20 per 1M, added 2026-09-28) and 0.025x on Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 ($0.25 per 1M, since 2026-09-07); DeepSeek holds the deepest discount in the tracked set at 98% ($0.003 off a $0.15 base), while OpenAI and Google remain at a flat 90%
key_facts.source: Official pricing pages of Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, retrieved 2026-09-28

key_facts.fact: Long-context pricing structures diverged: Google and xAI bill roughly 2x per token above 200K-token prompts, OpenAI lists a long-context tier on 10 of its 12 tracked rows (all except GPT-5.4-mini and GPT-5.4-nano; e.g. GPT-5.6-sol $8.00/$30.00 against a $4.00/$20.00 base), and Anthropic alone bills its full 1M-token context window at standard rates
key_facts.source: Google, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic pricing pages, retrieved 2026-09-28

key_facts.fact: The LLM API market is splitting: frontier prices are rising (Fable 5 at 2x Opus, OpenAI pro models at $30/$180) while sub-frontier prices continue to deflate
key_facts.source: jsonhouse analysis of official pricing pages, 2026-07-16

key_facts.fact: Mistral repositioned its former flagship Mistral Large 3 at $0.50/$1.50 per 1M tokens — one third the price of the newer Mistral Medium 3.5 ($1.50/$7.50)

OpenAI cut GPT-5.6-sol 20% on input and 33% on output to $4.00 / $20.00 on 2026-08-24, a promotional rate stated as available at least through 2026-11-21; earlier cuts on 2026-08-03 took GPT-5.6-luna down 80% to $0.20 / $1.20 and GPT-5.6-terra down 20% to $2.00 / $12.00, neither of which moved this week

Price cuts arrived as new model IDs rather than as repricing: on 2026-09-28 Claude Opus 5.5 listed at $4/$20 (20% under Claude Opus 5's unchanged $5/$25), GPT-6-sol at $2/$10 (half of GPT-5.6-sol's promotional $4/$20) and GPT-6-luna at $0.10/$0.50 (against GPT-5.6-luna's unchanged $0.20/$1.20), while no existing row was repriced
key_facts.source: Anthropic and OpenAI pricing pages, retrieved 2026-09-28; jsonhouse weekly snapshot comparison

faq_summary.q: What is the cheapest LLM API in 2026?
faq_summary.a: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite at $0.10 input / $0.40 output per 1M tokens. GPT-6-luna, added 2026-09-28, ties it on input and cached input at $0.10 / $0.01 and costs $0.50 on output. DeepSeek follows at $0.15 / $0.60 and leads on cached input at $0.003 per 1M tokens, a 98% discount.

faq_summary.q: Why is Claude Fable 5.1's cache read cheaper than Claude Opus 5's?
faq_summary.a: Anthropic prices a cache hit as a multiplier on base input and has not applied one multiplier to the whole line since 2026-09-07. Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 bill cache hits at 0.025x base input ($0.25 per 1M), Opus 5.5 at 0.05x ($0.20), and every other Claude model, Opus 5 included, at 0.1x.

faq_summary.q: Are per-token prices directly comparable across providers?
faq_summary.a: Only approximately. Anthropic's newest models tokenize the same text into roughly 30% more tokens than earlier Claude models, so identical sticker prices can produce different invoices. Compare cost per task, not cost per token.

faq_summary.q: Do these prices include long-context surcharges?
faq_summary.a: No — base tiers only. Google and xAI roughly double rates above 200K-token prompts; OpenAI lists a long-context tier on 10 of its 12 tracked rows; Anthropic bills its 1M context at standard rates.

faq_summary.q: How often is this table updated?
faq_summary.a: Weekly, from official provider pages only, with every change recorded in the changelog. Missed weeks are marked as gaps rather than back-filled: the 2026-07-20 and 2026-07-27 snapshots were not taken. The series began 2026-07-16.
